We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role

Industrious signs new landlord partnerships every year, and the number is growing as our business development team expands. Before any of those deals move forward, someone has to check that it holds together: that the assumptions are sound, that the start date, budgets, rent, pricing, and returns all track, and that the figures from design and construction have carried through correctly. As a Real Estate Associate on our Real Estate Transactions team that will be your job!

You will underwrite assigned deals in Excel, explain what drives their returns, and flag where a deal is tight, whether on pricing, occupancy, or CapEx. Our business development colleagues make the call on whether a deal goes ahead, and your analysis is what they rely on to make it well. You will work with Design, Construction, Finance, and other teams to make sure every number is right, supporting several business development colleagues as deal flow shifts.

Our approach to underwriting is different from a traditional real estate shop, and we will teach it to you. In your first few months you will get close review and clear guidance while you learn how we work. You will also join at a good time: the team is growing, new roles are being added, and we are underwriting a new product, so there is real room to learn, ask questions, and grow with us.

Success here means accurate work. The team trusts your numbers, your flags are clear, and any mistake you make happens once, not twice.

What Might Your Day Look Like

Your morning starts with a new deal from one of our business development colleagues. You go through the model piece by piece: the start date, the budget, the rent and revenue share assumptions, the cash flows, the IRR, and the margin the location is expected to earn per rentable square foot. The returns look fine at first, but pricing is tighter than it seems, so you note it clearly with the number that would need to change.

Late morning, updated figures arrive from Design and Construction. You check that they have flowed into the model correctly. One CapEx figure does not match the construction budget, so you confirm the right number with the construction team before it goes any further.

In the afternoon, you walk your business development colleague through the deal: what the returns look like, where the risk sits, and which assumptions matter most. They decide what happens next. Then priorities shift, and another colleague needs support on a deal heading to Investment Committee, so you move over and check that every figure in the review material ties back to the underwriting.

Before you wrap up, you update your trackers and checklists so the team knows where every deal you are supporting stands.

What You Will Own

- Underwrite assigned deals in Excel
